_counted: Counted, not measured: QI01 looks at every bottle that reaches it and sends some back, so what this characteristic holds is two whole numbers per stretch of production - how many were looked at and how many went back - and its chart is a p chart. No `min`/`max`: there is nothing to be in spec about on one bottle, and what judges a stretch is the control limits of its own chart. No `sample_size` either; a count is not a sample.
